8004.gloss: Selection quality swings by hiring manager for 45.8%
8004.verbatim: 45.8% of HR and TA practitioners describe their process as inconsistent — confidence that it picks the best candidate rather than the best interviewer varies by hiring manager or role (n=131). [Q4]
8004.source_note: SHRM Labs x Testlify: Skills Assessments — Topline Report

8011.gloss: 44.5% say no one formally validates their assessments
8011.verbatim: 44.5% of HR and TA practitioners say no one formally validates their assessments — the team goes on gut feel (n=128). [Q9]
8011.source_note: SHRM Labs x Testlify: Skills Assessments — Topline Report
